title: Germany's Soviet past looms over high-stakes election in Saxony-Anhalt: 'I do not consider Russians to be enemies'

title: Jordan Bardella backs embattled far-right British ally Nigel Farage
subhead: The annual conference of the far-right Reform UK party was overshadowed on Friday in Birmingham by revelations of attempts to circumvent party funding laws. title: Spanish fashion giant Mango: From small clothing shop to its founder's tragic death
subhead: In May, Jonathan Andic was arrested on suspicion of murdering his 71-year-old father, who fell to his death in a ravine in 2024. It was a shocking and tragic end for Isak Andic, a son of Turkish immigrants who turned a small second-hand clothing shop in Barcelona into a thriving textile empire over the course of nearly four decades.

title: French left renews push to raise inheritance taxes, from forced philanthropy to wealth transfer cap
